statement: As of 2026-09-24, all 314 official 500盤 2026 restaurant slots have a Tier-1 disposition under the <=NT$500 normal-solo-meal rule: 14 strong survivors, 96 Tier-2 candidates, 70 shared-format risks, 21 hard exclusions, 111 reversible screen-out signals, 1 operational watch, and 1 unresolved image-only corpus slot.
notes: Tier-1 disposition is deliberately high-recall. SURVIVE_CONFIRMED is not identical to final stable QUALIFIED; DROP_T1_SIGNAL is reversible and must not be treated as exact budget-floor proof.
